name: getRequestProfile
description: Returns the folded sampling call tree for the current request as a struct: { sampleCount, root }. Each node has function, template, line, self, total, selfPercent, totalPercent, and a children array. The data comes from the FusionReactor-style threshold-gated sampling profiler, which snapshots the CFML call stack on an interval for requests that run longer than the configured threshold.

examples.title: Dump the request's call tree
examples.description: Show the sampled profile of the current request.
